verdict.rationale: Plausible ships its own web tracking script, a WordPress plugin and a GTM template for web ingestion. For mobile (Android/iOS) and server-side tracking, the docs only point to the raw HTTP Events API, with no official language or platform SDKs. Event ingestion across all three surfaces exists, but the SDK part of the story is only met on the web. missing for 10: official mobile SDKs (iOS/Android), official backend SDKs for major languages, an OpenAPI spec or client libraries, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send events from web, mobile, and backend apps through official SDKs for the major languages and platforms

citations.quote: The Plausible Events API can be used to record pageviews and custom events. This is useful when tracking Android or iOS mobile apps, or for server side tracking.
Add the script to your site
Works with modern frameworks and supports SPAs out of the box, including pushState and hash-based routing.
